317-1475-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-1475-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat.

813-1777-2171.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Persist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

971-2113-4687.notablePrerequisites: Pentad Prism has at least four counters on it.
971-2113-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1479-2841-3585-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3585-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

5751-6462-7104-7105-8095.description:
Cast Tower Winder from your graveyard by paying {1}{G} and discarding Command Tower
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Tower Winder enters, it triggers, returning Command Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2279-4247-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

341-1170-4779-5131--202.easyPrerequisites:
Umori has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
341-1170-4779-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Umori.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Repeat.

215-2079-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-2079-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

240-955-2292-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

240-413-4742-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

618-4783-5686.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hellkite Courser with haste.
The Hellkite Courser token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
Choose to return Kiki-Jiki to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar trigger from step 3.
Resolve the Hellkite Courser trigger from step 2, putting Kiki-Jiki from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2341-2495-6893.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting The Eternity Elevator and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting The Eternity Elevator and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping The Eternity Elevator and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.
2341-2495-6893.notes: You can use either of The Eternity Elevator's mana abilities if you're able to do so.

3043-3525.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.

654-907-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
654-907-5702-6850.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters, Amulet of Vigor, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1563-2457-4094-6968.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

3293-5414-5531.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
You do not have any static effects boosting your creatures' toughness.
3293-5414-5531.description:
Cast Lumra by paying {4}{G}{G}.
When Lumra enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
When you sacrifice the last land, Lumra will die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Lumra trigger from step 2, causing you to mill four cards and return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Lumra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
3293-5414-5531.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1395-1987-3139-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and The Great Henge by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and The Great Henge.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

132-1632-2645.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Stonespeaker Crystal's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
132-1632-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use any other ability from Staff of Domination in step 1 instead.

2835-6249-6797--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2835-6249-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4484-5256-6440.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
4484-5256-6440.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

1236-2018-4779.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Rattleblaze Scarecrow.
When Rattleblaze Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Rattleblaze Scarecrow didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Rattleblaze Scarecrow from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Rattleblaze Scarecrow is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

428-1694-2719-5541.notablePrerequisites:
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
428-1694-2719-5541.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

3605-5145-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2146-5173-5553-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2438-3327.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-2438-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

654-678-2034-5464.description:
Cast Goldvein Hydra by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Goldvein Hydra, adding {C}{C}.
When Goldvein Hydra dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Goldvein Hydra from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goldvein Hydra trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
654-678-2034-5464.notes: Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may cast Goldvein Hydra with X equaling an arbitrarily large number, and then kill it to get infinite tapped Treasure tokens.

1794-4424-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
1794-4424-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper, adding {R}.
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Ruthless Ripper triggers, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

539-577-4552.description:
Activate Soldevi Simulacrum by paying {0} due to Blossoming Tortoise, giving Soldevi Simulacrum +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

643-2060-2445-3525-5121.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Urtet.
Urtet does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
643-2060-2445-3525-5121.description:
Activate Urtet by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, putting six +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, as they are all Myrs due to Maskwood Nexus.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Urtet.
Repeat.

2060-2090-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least six +1/+1 counters on it.
Bright-Palm does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2060-2090-3750.description:
Declare Bright-Palm as an attacker.
Bright-Palm triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

512-4050-4694.notablePrerequisites: Halo Fountain does not have summoning sickness.
512-4050-4694.description:
Activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping it and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Citizen, adding {W}.
Repeat.

628-4050-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 1 until Deathbringer Thoctar has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Deathbringer Thoctar, adding one mana of any color.
Deathbringer Thoctar dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

444-567-1722-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
444-567-1722-2034.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Soul's Attendant, causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Drogskol Reaver trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1987-3075-3277-3573.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.You control at least two artifacts.
1987-3075-3277-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
